resources.string: Choose a file or retained original, then choose its range. This source’s remark, the node body and the last preview are kept. The previous source file is unchanged.
This shows the last saved content. Unsaved drafts are not added or saved.
A PDF needs separate confirmation before it is retained in the original library.
Keep this PDF in the original library? It remains there even if you later cancel replacing the source. The selected PDF file is not modified.
This exact PDF is in the original library’s trash. Restore it before selecting its page or region? Its permanent page identities are preserved.
Drag to draw a region, or drag its edge or middle to adjust it. Use two fingers or Pan to move the view.
This selects a page or region of the original PDF, without note annotations.
Checking the selected source and range…
The source change is saved. Later edits still need saving.
The source change is kept, but saving has not finished. Retry saves the current map without changing the source again.
The source content or reference changed. Reload or select the source again.
The source could not be read completely. Reload it, or return to choose a different source.
Select the region again. Original PDF regions must stay inside the actual page.
Choose a page, or select Whole file.
No retained originals to select on this page.
Original library details are not supported.
Map sources currently support Whole file only.
Page reference activation did not finish. Continue the same retained activation explicitly. Completed activation is kept if you cancel changing the source.
